$comment: Dependency advisories we have SEEN and DECIDED about. Not a mute button.
scripts/audit-check.mjs fails the build on any high or critical advisory
that is not listed here, on any entry listed here that no longer appears
(so the file cannot rot), and on any entry past its reviewBy date (so an
accepted risk cannot quietly become permanent).
Adding an entry is a decision with a name and a date on it, the same rule
the breaker reset follows. If you cannot write an honest reason, the answer
is to fix the dependency, not to add the entry.
acceptedBy null means PROPOSED, not decided. The reasoning below was
written during the 2026-08-12 audit sweep; nobody has signed it off. The
check prints these as UNCONFIRMED on every run rather than passing them off
as settled. Set acceptedBy when the call is actually made.

accepted.reason: Transitively vulnerable through postcss and sharp. The only fix npm offers is next 16, a breaking major. DECIDED 2026-08-19: take the upgrade, before launch, as its own dedicated change — see FUTURENORMA.md §4 open decision 3b and the launch checklist in PATHWAYS.md §7. The 2026-08-16 trial at next@16.3.1 went to npm audit 0 with the suite 635/635 green and the nonce CSP intact, so this entry and the postcss and sharp ones below are accepted only until that upgrade lands, not until the review date. The upgrade is for dependency health; it does not license serving uploaded images through next/image (§10.5 3A).

Reached only through next's bundled copy. The advisories are XSS via unescaped </style> and arbitrary .map file disclosure via attacker-controlled sourceMappingURL — both need attacker-controlled CSS reaching the build. Our CSS is authored in this repo; no customer input is compiled. Real, but not reachable on our paths today.

libvips CVEs, reached through next's image optimiser. We do not serve user-uploaded images through next/image, and that is now a decision rather than an accident: Harsha settled on 2026-08-19 that uploaded artifacts render as plain from short-lived presigned GET URLs, so customer bytes never reach sharp. PATHWAYS.md §10.5 3A carries the instruction and the reasoning; web/app/_components/Screenshot.tsx is the precedent for our own images. Verified 2026-08-19: no next/image anywhere under web/app/r/. This entry stands only while that holds — anything that would put uploaded images through the optimiser re-opens it rather than quietly making this sentence false.
